post.description: Asks Lyro to answer a ticket in Tidio.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

ticketId.description: Tidio ticket identifier to answer with Lyro.

contactEmail.description: Email address of the contact tied to the ticket.

contactName.description: Display name of the contact tied to the ticket.

recipientEmail.description: Recipient email where the Lyro answer will be sent.

messages.description: Conversation messages used as Lyro context.

messages[].createdAt.description: Message creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

messages[].messageId.description: Unique ULID of the conversation message.

messages[].authorType.description: Message author type. Tidio currently accepts contact only.

messages[].messageType.description: Message visibility type. Tidio currently accepts public only.

messages[].attachments.description: Optional attachment URLs for the message.

messages[].messageContent.description: Body text of the conversation message.

get.description: Retrieves messages for a contact from Tidio.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

conversationUrl.description: URL to view the conversation in Tidio panel

authorId.description: Author ID of the message. When "author_type" is "operator", the operator ID is returned. When "author_type" is contact, the contact ID is returned. Null is returned for the rest of the "author_type" values.

createdAt.description: Date when message has been sent

cursor.description: Value to fetch the next page. Null means the page is the last one.

limit.description: How many items were displayed on list
